rows.summary: tests/pdf/05-fonts.test.mjs no longer touches the network: its web fonts (Gelasio, Bebas Neue, the 11 picker fonts, Noto Sans Math and Symbols 2) come from tests/pdf/fake-fontsource.mjs, which answers each package's metadata.json as jsDelivr served it on 2026-10-06 and each face with a real WOFF made from the bundled Noto Sans, its name table rewritten to the face asked for ('Gelasio-BoldItalic'); the two symbol fonts draw only the characters the file prints in them. Any other URL rejects naming itself, is listed, and fails the case that asked (the app swallows a failed font fetch, so the rejection alone would pass as a quiet fallback); every connection from the process to a non-loopback address is refused and listed (net.Socket#connect). All 19 old cases keep their assertions verbatim (nothing weakened); only the live pre-flight request isOnline() and its skip('offline') lines are gone, so the 14 cases that skipped offline now always run. 4 new cases: every one of the 15 packages was answered by the stand-in and nothing unexpected/refused was recorded for the whole file; Gelasio's six faces are fontkit fonts named for weight and style; an unknown URL fails loudly; a connection beyond this machine is refused. CI, each log read to the end ('# tests 23 # pass 23 # fail 0 # skipped 0', lint job green, file runs in 3-4 s): 37419868823 (on 97ee474e; the same path given three times in one input ran ONCE: node de-duplicates paths), 37420090025, 37420102923, 37420115823 (97ee474e, three separate dispatches) and, on the final head 8f80370a, 37420989339, 37421433266, 37421451484. Mutation proof (throwaway branch claude/wf-1006f-fonts-mutation2 @ 176fd447, three deliberate breaks: stand-in without Gelasio, every face asked for upright, wrong symbol-font package name): run 37420977532 read to the end: 23 tests, 8 pass, 15 fail = the Georgia/Gelasio case ('NotoSans-Bold, NotoSans-Regular'), the 11 picker-font cases ('Inter-Bold, Inter-Regular': Italic missing), the arrows/check-marks case (check mark missing) and 2 stand-in cases; the offline default-font case, Bebas Neue, the no-such-font case, the 3 medium-weight cases and the 2 refusal cases still pass. An earlier mutation run (37420203921 on ab224eca, read to the end) failed 21 for the same breaks because one unknown URL failed every later case; 8f80370a made the check throw once, for the case that asked.

Read at HEAD: the donor half of the row is ALREADY FIXED by R4-LO-17 (1593271f, 6ed8b10c, 86244253, d0a5f28a; tests/pdf/101-r4-lo-17-font-face-retry): a face that failed once is fetched again a minute on (at once if it failed offline or the browser comes back online) and prints in its own data; the R4 tracker's 'remaining' note for R4-PDF-02 is stale. Reading pdfFontLoader.js found two things still true at HEAD: (1) a face the CDN lacks (404) is fetched again every minute for the rest of the session; (2) a back-up family (the chosen font's own latin-ext, a symbol font, a script's Noto font) whose faces ALL failed is never fetched again: react-pdf keeps the failed load for good and only the chosen font's own family is forgotten (familyChain), so one dropped connection leaves the Ł in Noto Sans's latin-ext, or a check mark unprinted, until reload; a back-up family whose fetch stalled never gets a new fetch either. A candidate fix and 12 tests are in ONE commit, 996355b4, on branch claude/wf-1006f-fonts-f1-candidate (on top of 8f80370a): a 404 face is remembered as gone (never fetched again, not counted as borrowing); a back-up family that failed whole joins the existing borrowed-face schedule (a minute on, 0 offline, at 'online', a stalled face gets a new fetch); a fetch again is waited for within the build's one deadline instead of a fixed 3 s. THE CANDIDATE IS UNPROVEN: it was written after reading the code, then the owner asked to wrap up; no CI run of it was dispatched or read (no tests, no failfirst, no lint). It is NOT on this branch.
rows.remaining: Prove or drop 996355b4 before merging it. (a) failfirst: `failfirst="996355b4:tests/pdf/1006f-font-retry-backoff.test.mjs"` on ref claude/wf-1006f-fonts-f1-candidate; by my trace the run should say `# fail 7` without the fix (the 404-face-in-a-loaded-family case, the latin-ext, symbol-font, stalled, offline and online cases, and the wait-bound case); the 3 status cases, the two-builds-at-once case and the 404-subset case are regression guards that pass either way. (b) `tests` on the same ref: tests/pdf/1006f-font-retry-backoff.test.mjs tests/pdf/05-fonts.test.mjs tests/pdf/05-fonts-scripts.test.mjs tests/pdf/01-text-extraction.test.mjs tests/pdf/101-r4-lo-17-font-face-retry.test.mjs tests/pdf/101-r4-lo-17-face-fetched-rebuild.test.mjs tests/pdf/113-font-load-stall.test.mjs tests/pdf/118-font-late-face-prepared.test.mjs tests/pdf/119-font-metadata-deadline.test.mjs tests/pdf/120-font-wait-grace.test.mjs tests/pdf/121-main-thread-build-overrun.test.mjs tests/pdf/112-pdf-worker-watchdog.test.mjs tests/pdf/126-r2-142-pdf-worker-watchdog.test.mjs tests/pdf/92-font-fallback-notice.test.mjs tests/pdf/93-name-heading-font.test.mjs tests/pdf/97-font-cache.test.mjs tests/pdf/97-woff-glyf-once.test.mjs tests/pdf/r4pdf-font-notice.test.mjs tests/pdf/r5hunt6-card-picture-degraded.test.mjs tests/pdf/105-r5-hunt5-typography-own-custom-font.test.mjs tests/pdf/13-sidebar.test.mjs tests/pdf/164-sidebar-token-break.test.mjs tests/pdf/40-ats-parse.test.mjs tests/pdf/41-word-gaps.test.mjs tests/pdf/85-font-glyph-coverage.test.mjs tests/pdf/71-startup-chunks.test.mjs. The riskiest part is moving prepareFonts' fetched-face loop before the donor assignment and the new early returns in loadInTime; tests 92, 101, 113, 118, 119, 120 are the ones that would show a regression. If a font test goes red, drop the commit: F2 does not depend on it. 71-startup-chunks: not run; the loader is lazy and fontFallback.js changed only in a comment.

notes: Merge boundary: claude/wf-1006f-fonts (this branch) = F2 only + this report; its code head before the report is 8f80370a. The F1 candidate lives on claude/wf-1006f-fonts-f1-candidate (996355b4, base 8f80370a), deliberately not on this branch so an unproven change cannot ship with the proven one. Throwaway branches on GitHub, never to be merged, which I may not delete: claude/wf-1006f-fonts-mutation (ab224eca) and claude/wf-1006f-fonts-mutation2 (176fd447): both hold deliberate breaks of src/templates/pdf/shared/pdfFontLoader.js, pdfFontCoverage.js and the stand-in. No independent reviewer was spawned (the worker rules forbid sub-agents). How the stand-in's bytes were made, and what it cannot prove: only @fontsource/noto-sans is installed, so every text face is a real Noto Sans WOFF renamed, and the symbol fonts are Noto Sans with a cmap of a few characters; the test reads text and embedded font names, never glyph shapes, so it no longer proves that Google's own files for Gelasio, Inter... parse in fontkit (the live run did, by accident). Real files would need committed fixtures (about 6 faces x 13 fonts, several MB); I did not commit any binary. The metadata values came from a read of the 15 metadata.json files on 2026-10-06 (web fetch, nothing saved). Follow-ups, not done (new bugs seen): nine other test files still reach the live font CDN with a pre-flight and skip or flake the same way when it is slow: tests/pdf/05-fonts-scripts (10 cases guarded by skip('offline')), 164-sidebar-token-break (6), 85-font-glyph-coverage (2), 01-text-extraction (1), 13-sidebar (1), 74-academic-look, parity/12-fonts, parity/17-lists, and 94-bullet-style, which decides which cases EXIST at load time from a live fetch (a slow CDN silently drops its 'circle' case). The stand-in already serves the Latin picker fonts and the two symbol fonts those need; CJK, Arabic, Hebrew and emoji (05-fonts-scripts) need real script fonts, which are not in node_modules. The R4-TRACKER row for R4-PDF-02 should say R4-LO-17 closed the donor half. Not claimed: 71-startup-chunks was not run (F2 is test-only; the F1 candidate is not measured). Accessibility: nothing seen, nothing touched.
